description: This Java class defines TbelCfTsRollingArg, a data structure for handling time-series rolling data with statistical methods such as max, min, average, median, standard deviation, and merge operations. It implements iterable and exposes various statistical computations on a list of TbelCfTsDoubleVal objects within a specified time window.

classes.name: TbelCfTsRollingArg
classes.description: A class representing a rolling time window of time-series data with statistical analysis methods, supporting merging and iteration.

methods.name: TbelCfTsRollingArg
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a time window and list of values, or with a duration in milliseconds.

methods.name: memorySize
methods.description: Calculates the approximate memory size of the object.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: avg
methods.description: Returns the average of values, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Calculates the mean value, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: std
methods.description: Calculates the standard deviation, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: median
methods.description: Calculates the median value, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Counts the number of non-NaN values, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: last
methods.description: Returns the last value, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: first
methods.description: Returns the first value, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Calculates the sum of values, optionally ignoring NaN.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges this object with another TbelCfTsRollingArg.

methods.name: mergeAll
methods.description: Merges multiple TbelCfTsRollingArg objects into a TbelCfTsRollingData.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the values list.
